List of lighting sources and its implementations to an image.

h4#directional. Directional

* !post #5185860: [[backlighting]]: Light comes from behind the subject making a luminous contour
* !post #9706205: [[overlighting]]: Light comes from above usually making the face and torso shaded in contrast
* !post #5758679: [[sidelighting]]: Light comes from the left or right side
* !post #7729975: [[underlighting]]: Light comes from below, typically to create a ominous effect

h4#types. Types

* !post #6970897: [[bloom]]: Bright areas that blur with surrounding areas
* !post #5938276: [[spotlight]]: A cone-shaped light from above on a target
* !post #9091432: [[spotlight]]: A circle-shaped light on a target
* !post #438675: [[light rays]] ([[sunbeam]])
* !post #3100996: [[light rays]] ([[moonbeam]])
* !post #949063: [[light rays]] ([[underwater]])
* !post #7834427: [[dim lighting]]: For dimly lit posts

* !post #12099830: [[moonlight]] and [[sunlight]]

h6. Light through gaps
* !post #3066890: [[crack of light]]: A small amount of light in a dark scene, usually from opening a door to a dark room
* !post #1054608: [[dappled sunlight]]: [[Sunlight]] seen through the [[shadow]] cast by leaves of a [[tree]]
* !post #3225622: [[dappled moonlight]]
* !post #10100307: [[window shadow]]: [[Shadow]] cast by a [[window]]

h6. Light through objects
* !post #8181198: [[caustics]]: Light patterns on a surface formed by light traveling through a transparent material
* !post #9909986: [[caustics]] ([[water]])
* !post #4150718: [[caustics]] ([[underwater]])
* !post #5527065: [[dispersion (optics)]]: [[Rainbow]]-colored light formed when light passes through a transparent object like a [[prism]]
* !post #6899388: [[refraction]]: Changing the angle of light when it passes through an object
* !post #4900932: [[refraction]]: A lens effect inverts the image through a [[glass]] of [[water]]
* !post #4151443: [[subsurface scattering]]: Light visible through a solid object
